name: Launchpane
summary: App store publishing dashboard for an indie studio, with phone-style glass and a live island
about: A dashboard for a small studio that sells apps on a phone app store, built from frosted glass cards and phone-style controls over a soft pastel wallpaper, light and dark. Follow downloads, proceeds and payouts, answer reviews, edit your store listing while a phone preview updates, move builds through review to release and track search keywords. A live island at the top springs open for every sale, review and build update.
how: Watch the island at the top: it opens for live downloads, purchases, reviews and build updates. Click it to jump to that page.
Switch Week, Month or Year on Summary and Sales to morph the charts; on Sales, pick one app or all apps.
Open an app's Store page to edit its subtitle, promotional text, price and category and see the phone preview change as you type.
On Releases, drag a version between stages or press Next step and Release. New version checks that the number is higher than the live one.
Reviews has star filters, a rating breakdown and public replies. Keywords tracks store search ranks.
Payouts lists monthly payouts with a CSV export; Settings has phone-style switches, the theme and Reset demo data.
